question: Which Anuttara Kaulinī yoginī is identified with the supreme-bliss power and the syllable sauḥ?
premises: It includes the transmitted syllable sauḥ.
The colophon identifies it as the root mantra of Anuttara Kaulinī Yoginī.
inference: This transmitted formula is the root mantra of Anuttara Kaulinī Yoginī as supreme-bliss power.
plain_english: “Parānandamayī śaktiḥ, sauḥ” — thus is the root mantra of Anuttara Kaulinī Yoginī.
